name: Integration Tests
on: 
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - '**.md'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - '!.github/workflows/IntegrationTests.yml'
  pull_request:
  repository_dispatch:
  workflow_dispatch:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.head_ref || '' }}-${{ github.base_ref || '' }}-${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:

  format-check:
    name: Format Check
    runs-on: ${{ github.repository_owner == 'duckdb' && 'namespace-profile-linux-slim' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: 'true'
      - run: |
          python -m pip install --user --break-system-packages \
            black==25.1.0        \
            clang_format==11.0.1 \
            cmake-format==0.6.13
          export PATH=~/.local/bin:$PATH
          python -m pip show black
          python -m pip show cmake_format
          python -m pip show clang_format
          which clang-format
          clang-format --version
          make format-check

  linux-tests:
    name: Linux (pg-17)
    needs: format-check
    runs-on: ${{ github.repository_owner == 'duckdb' && 'namespace-profile-linux-x64' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}

    env:
      GEN: ninja
      CC: '/usr/lib/ccache/gcc'
      CXX: '/usr/lib/ccache/g++'
      CCACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/ccache
      VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET: x64-linux-release
      VCPKG_HOST_TRIPLET: x64-linux-release
      VCPKG_TOOLCHAIN_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        submodules: 'true'

    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        echo "set man-db/auto-update false" | sudo debconf-communicate || true
        sudo dpkg-reconfigure man-db || true
        sudo apt-get update -y -q -o=Dpkg::Use-Pty=0
        sudo apt-get install -y -q -o=Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 \
          build-essential \
          ccache \
          cmake \
          ninja-build

    - name: Cache Key
      id: cache_key
      working-directory: ./duckdb
      run: |
        DUCKDB_VERSION=$(git rev-parse --short=10 HEAD)
        KEY="${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-$DUCKDB_VERSION"
        echo "value=${KEY}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

    - name: Restore Cache
      uses: actions/cache/restore@v5
      with:
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/ccache
        key: ${{ steps.cache_key.outputs.value }}

    - name: Setup vcpkg
      uses: lukka/run-vcpkg@v11.1
      with:
        vcpkgGitCommitId: 9e593bb18ea69cc5095e012465dcd675a822ed0d # Release 2026.07.29

    - name: Build extension
      run: |
        make release

    - name: Save Cache
      uses: actions/cache/save@v5
      with:
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/ccache
        key: ${{ steps.cache_key.outputs.value }}

    - name: Setup Postgres
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-postgres
      with:
        postgres-version: 17
        ssl: false

    - name: Run tests
      env:
        PGHOST: localhost
        PGPORT: 5432
        PGUSER: postgres
        PGPASSWORD: postgres
        POSTGRES_TEST_DATABASE_AVAILABLE: 1
        POSTGRES_CONNECTION_IS_DIRECT: 1
        LOCAL_EXTENSION_REPO: 'build/release/repository'
      run: |
        source ./create-postgres-tables.sh
        psql -d postgresscanner -c "SELECT 42"
        ./build/release/test/unittest 'test/sql/*'

  linux-pgbouncer:
    name: Linux Pg

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
